SOURCE ONLY / UNVERIFIED. Main applies hunks into a new worktree; no current source or old packet is changed.
Base: integrated WN0691bcdf. Four modified existing files, one new CPU fixture. No GPU/model/runtime dependency is introduced by the proposed target.
Gate: STRATA_IQ256_PAIRED_GU must equal exactly 1; frozen thread-safe local-static first-use decision, default OFF. No namespace-scope AVX initializer. The established cpu_avx2_ok dispatcher gate remains mandatory; direct public test entry requires the same gate.
Eligibility: IQ3_S type21, NT1, H2560, FF640 layout (row1100, up704000), plain AVX2 variant0 or existing gather1. VNNI, other shapes/types/NT returnfalse and production uses untouched baseline. NT8/default gather selection/down/SYCL/precision/math policies unchanged.
Each projection retains its original block i, half j/half order, existing Fmt32 decoding, sign/maddubs/madd_add, per-block float multiplication/FMA, hsum8 reduction and SiLU expression. Gate/up computations are interleaved; only activation-vector load is shared. No reassociation/new gather/fast-math. Instruction emission/load elimination/spills are NOT established by source inspection.
Pointer contract: typed naturally aligned live block_q8_K[10], immutable byte weights >=1408000 bytes, live writable float[640], mutually disjoint; pointer arrays have >=1 entries. Production caller already owns these synchronous buffers. No new allocation/thread/asynchronous lifetime. API rejects null/shape/row/variant before reading payload; cannot validate caller allocation extents or illegal aliasing. Counters/global mutable state absent; flag is process-frozen so OFF/ON require fresh processes.
R263 geometry correction: H2560 has10 Q8_K blocks of256 values (2920 bytes); FF640 has20 IQ4_NL blocks of32 values, not80. Existing report left untouched.
Fixture calls real unchanged iq256_gu_rows_v and paired_v, scalar/gather, every640 GU row, four deterministic activation patterns, valid random IQ3_S index/sign/scale bytes with finite positive/negative FP16 scales, natural typed Q8_K objects filled by actual quantizer, unaligned byte weights, partitioned row tails and adjacent canaries. Unsupported NT0/2/8, type20, VNNI and row641 must leave output unchanged. Native format eligibility is checked. Actual production wrapper is compared to its selected baseline; direct candidate comparisons do not prove automatic dispatcher selected candidate on VNNI hosts.
No compile/test/import/AST/lint/GPU/model/process/Git/cleanup executed. Source changes and fixture need Main review and qualification. No parity/speed/spill-free/model-quality claim.
